data.name: IntroBody
data.value: MealPlanner ("the app") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

data.name: DataCollectedBody
data.value: When you create an account we collect your email address, username, and password (stored securely as a hash, never in plain text). We also store the recipes, products, meal plans, shopping lists, and shops you create while using the app.

data.name: DataUseBody
data.value: We use this information solely to provide the meal planning, recipe, and shopping list features of the app. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

data.name: DataStorageBody
data.value: Your data is stored in a secured database and is only accessible through your authenticated account.

data.name: DataRetentionBody
data.value: We retain your data for as long as your account remains active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

data.name: YourRightsBody
data.value: You can access, update, or delete your personal data at any time from within the app, or by contacting us using the Contact Us page.

data.name: ChildrenBody
data.value: MealPlanner is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

data.name: ChangesBody
data.value: We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

data.name: ContactBody
data.value: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please reach out via the Contact Us page in the app.
